svg.title: Two decision ladders: orchestration and AI binding
svg.desc: Orchestration ladder, bottom to top: Webflow publish; Cloudflare Worker; Durable Object; Xano as the system of record; hyperscaler or BYOC cluster. AI binding ladder, bottom to top: no model; Workers AI binding; AI Gateway to a hosted model; agent with tools on Xano; dedicated GPUs. Each rung names the condition that earns the next one. Rules on every rung: Xano wins disagreements, fail closed when stale, personal data stays home, egress only through the signed gate.
svg.text: TWO DECISION LADDERS — START AT THE BOTTOM, CLIMB ONLY WHEN THE CONDITION IS TRUE
each rung up adds cost, latency or audit scope; the grey line on each rung is the condition that earns the next one
Heavy box = where the record of truth lives.
ORCHESTRATION · WHERE THE LOGIC RUNS
0 · Webflow publish
Pages and CMS output served from a CDN; no per-request logic
climb when: a request needs a decision, not a page
1 · Cloudflare Worker
Route, cache, check auth and consent at the edge
climb when: the decision needs memory of one subject
2 · Durable Object
Per-subject state; a projection of the record, never the truth
climb when: the action must change the record
3 · Xano, the system of record
Postgres, business rules, an append-only ledger, one per region
climb when: one instance can't meet residency or load
4 · Hyperscaler or BYOC cluster
Xano Enterprise in your cloud account; warehouses, batch jobs
climb when: a contract or a regulator requires it
AI BINDING · WHERE THE MODEL RUNS, WHAT IT MAY TOUCH
0 · No model
Deterministic rules in a Worker or a Xano function
climb when: the input is language, images or a fuzzy match
1 · Workers AI binding
Small models at the edge through env.AI: classify, embed, moderate
climb when: the task needs a frontier model
2 · AI Gateway to a hosted model
Claude, Gemini or GPT behind one gateway: logs, cache, limits
climb when: the model must read or write records
3 · Agent with tools on Xano
Tool calls hit Xano endpoints; every write passes the gate
climb when: hosted models fail on cost, privacy or tuning
4 · Dedicated GPUs
Self-host, fine-tune or train on neocloud or hyperscaler GPUs
climb when: the model weights are the product
RULES THAT HOLD ON EVERY RUNG
Xano wins any disagreement · fail closed when the projection is stale · personal data stays in its home instance · data leaves only through the signed gate
